title.zh: 第13课：我的新邻居来自英国
title.en: Lesson 13: My new neighbor is from the UK

dialogue.hanzi: 我新邻居来自英国，昨天刚搬进来。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ de xīn línjū láizì Yīngguó, zuótiān gāng bān jìnlái.

translation.en: My new neighbor is from the UK and just moved in yesterday.
translation.ar: جاري الجديد من بريطانيا، وقد انتقل إلى هنا أمس.

dialogue.hanzi: 你们见过面了吗？他会说中文吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐmen jiànguò miàn le ma? Tā huì shuō Zhōngwén ma?

translation.en: Have you met? Can he speak Chinese?

dialogue.hanzi: 见过了，他说得不错，还问我附近哪儿有超市。
dialogue.pinyin: Jiànguò le, tā shuō de búcuò, hái wèn wǒ fùjìn nǎr yǒu chāoshì.

translation.en: Yes. He speaks well and asked where the nearest supermarket is.
translation.ar: نعم، يتحدث جيداً وسألني عن أقرب متجر.

dialogue.hanzi: 下次你带他一起吃饭，我也想认识他。
dialogue.pinyin: Xiàcì nǐ dài tā yìqǐ chīfàn, wǒ yě xiǎng rènshi tā.

translation.en: Bring him to dinner next time; I’d like to meet him too.
translation.ar: أحضره معك إلى العشاء المرة القادمة، فأنا أود التعرف إليه أيضاً.

authoringNote: Original dialogue aligned to the lesson topic; translations and tone-marked pinyin are supplied for every turn.
